# Pixelette Certified

> UK-headquartered ISO certification and compliance consultancy. Fixed-fee. Senior-led. 98% first-attempt pass rate. Globally delivered across UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, EU, Americas, and APAC.

Pixelette Certified is operated by Pixelette Group Ltd (Companies House 07251823), registered in England and Wales. Office: 66 Paul Street, London, EC2A 4NA. Contact: info@pixelettecertified.com.

## What We Do

We help technology companies, FinTechs, healthcare providers, manufacturers, and government suppliers achieve ISO certification and regulatory compliance — faster, at fixed cost, with a 98% first-attempt pass rate.

Core services: ISO 27001 (information security), ISO 42001 (AI governance), ISO 22301 (business continuity), ISO 9001 (quality management), ISO 14001 (environmental), Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR / UK GDPR compliance, Virtual CISO (vCISO), Virtual DPO (vDPO), Penetration Testing (VAPT), and regional GRC frameworks (SAMA CSF, NCA ECC/CCC, QCB/NIA).

## Key Facts

- 50+ ISO certifications delivered
- 98% first-attempt audit pass rate
- 10-week standard delivery from kickoff to certificate
- Fixed-fee engagements (no hourly billing, no scope creep)
- ISO 27001 Certified Practice — we hold the same certification we help you achieve
- PECB-certified Lead Auditor on staff — among the first in the UK to offer ISO 42001
- Pixelette Pass-First Guarantee: if a failure occurs due to a gap in our documentation, we cover the remediation at no extra cost

## Services

- [ISO 27001 Certification](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-27001): Information Security Management System. 10-week implementation. UK government and enterprise supply chain standard.
- [ISO 42001 AI Governance](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-42001): AI Management System. EU AI Act aligned. PECB-certified auditor. Delivered in 14 weeks.
- [ISO 22301 Business Continuity](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-22301): Business Continuity Management. Disaster recovery, crisis management, resilience.
- [ISO 9001 Quality Management](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-9001): Quality Management System. Widely required in enterprise procurement.
- [ISO 14001 Environmental Management](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/iso-14001): Environmental Management System. ESG and sustainability obligations.
- [Cyber Essentials / CE Plus](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/cyber-essentials): UK government-backed. Required for public sector contracts. 2–3 week delivery.
- [vCISO](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vciso): Virtual Chief Information Security Officer. Fractional senior security leadership on a monthly retainer.
- [vDPO](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/vdpo): Virtual Data Protection Officer. GDPR compliance, DSR management, DPIAs, ICO liaison.
- [Penetration Testing](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/penetration-testing): VAPT — web application, API, network, and cloud. CVSS-scored reports.
- [GDPR & Privacy](https://pixelettecertified.com/services/gdpr-privacy): UK GDPR and EU GDPR compliance programmes.
